_comment: Copy to <repo>/.claude/quality-gates.json to turn on crap-gate.py (developer stop + commit) and mutation.py (code reviewer). Per language: extensions; coverage: command that writes the coverage file {report} (LCOV, or Go coverprofile with coverage_format gocover); test: fail-fast test command for mutants (auto-merge.py, local mode, also runs it as the full suite before merging); checks (optional, local mode): more completion checks auto-merge.py runs after test, same cwd, env and placeholders (format, lint): each an argv list (passes on exit 0), or {"argv": [...], "empty_output": true} that also fails on any output (e.g. ["gofmt", "-l", "."]); a failure refuses the merge, so the orchestrator doesn't run them by hand; cwd: where both run; env: extra variables ({repo}: this checkout, also from a scratch copy); invalid_exit_codes / invalid_patterns: results that mean the mutant didn't build. select (optional, Python with pytest-cov 7.1+): {"kind": "pytest-contexts", "pytest": the pytest command without paths, "python": the project's Python (it reads the coverage data), "fallback": tests for a line no test context covers, {component} = the path's first directory}: mutation runs only the tests that executed each mutated line, and a later scan after test-only changes reruns only what they can affect. red_invalid_patterns: output that means the branch's first tests commit fails for the wrong reason (crap-gate wants it red only because the implementation is missing; a missing module or name is fine). exclude: paths never checked (guard-paths tests and qaConfig are added). scratch_exclude: what the mutation copy leaves out ("dir/" from the root, a bare name anywhere). auto_merge_hold (local mode): paths that stop auto-merge.py for a person's review, on top of ~/.claude/hooks/auto-merge-hold.json (e.g. data config). limits: overrides of ~/.claude/hooks/quality-defaults.json. The hooks read this file (and guard-paths.json) as committed at the diff base, never the working tree: a change takes effect once merged. Commands run in bwrap (~/.claude/hooks/qg_sandbox.json): no network, $HOME empty except the configured tool and cache paths, so use installed tools and offline flags (uv run --no-sync).
